review_type: Independent AI source-only procedural review; not independent human expert review.

field_semantics.null: Not established or not applicable, as explained in the accompanying field; never a negative measurement.
field_semantics.basins: Committed body-basin count; null for every abstention.
field_semantics.rgb_b_agree: True means the committed topology was traceable in both native RGB and direct B; null for abstentions because agreement on required complete topology was not established.
field_semantics.branch_at_least_2px: True is the approximate native-pixel visibility judgment already reported for committed calls; null where complete required topology was not established.
field_semantics.approx_body_height_px_range: Manual approximate original-pixel interval from the completed review.
field_semantics.approx_crest_height_px_range: Outward-rounded envelope implied by the already reported body-height and crest/body ranges; no new measurement or test.
field_semantics.approx_crest_body_ratio_range: Manual approximate interval from the completed review, applicable only to committed w calls.

exposure_and_protocol_limits: Validation metadata exposed source labels; this review is not label-blind.
Whole-image RGB/B views provided coarse exposure to all rows before sequential close inspection.
Control metadata does not provide full-group locator boundaries; their required recording and split completeness cannot be independently verified from permitted inputs.
Frozen crops C140, C183 and V07 truncate required or potentially required outer stroke regions; no corrected-crop substitution or retest was performed.
Typewritten serif/body endpoints, baseline band, crest centerline, harmless terminal clipping and watermark traceability need more precise prospective operationalization.
Supplied source labels are transcription labels, not independently proven historical ground truth.
